variants.title: Budget unavailable time
variants.context: Availability is the fraction of an observation window in which the service is usable. Here the target applies to minutes.
variants.prompt: A window contains 1000 minutes. The target is 99% availability. How many unavailable minutes fit the target?
variants.hint: Multiply the window by the unavailable fraction.

variants.title: Remove a shared failure point
variants.context: A failure domain is a set of components that can fail together, such as machines depending on one power supply.
variants.prompt: Two application replicas share one machine. Which event can stop both?
options: Failure of a client that has no shared server dependencies.
A failure confined to a separate, unused machine.
variants.hint: Follow every dependency needed to serve the request.

variants.title: Recover and verify
variants.context: Recovery restores useful service and checks correctness before normal traffic resumes.
variants.prompt: A primary fails and a prepared standby is available. Arrange a safe response.

items.text: Fence the failed primary so it cannot accept writes.
Promote the prepared standby and route traffic.
Detect and confirm the primary failure.

variants.hint: Contain the failure, restore safely, and verify the outcome.
variants.explanation: Fencing prevents competing writers; verification checks the real service.
